name: Crypto Price Monitor
description: Fetches cryptocurrency prices every hour and sends to Telegram

config.code:
const prices = context.nodes['fetch-prices']; let message = '🪙 *Crypto Price Update*
━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━

'; const coins = []; for (const [coin, data] of Object.entries(prices)) { coins.push({ name: coin, price: data.usd, change: data.usd_24h_change || 0 }); } coins.sort((a, b) => b.price - a.price); for (const coin of coins) { const change = coin.change; const emoji = change >= 0 ? '📈' : '📉'; const coinName = coin.name.charAt(0).toUpperCase() + coin.name.slice(1).replace('-', ' '); const formattedPrice = coin.price >= 1 ? coin.price.toFixed(2) : coin.price.toFixed(6); message += `${emoji} *${coinName}*
💵 $${formattedPrice} (${change >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${change.toFixed(2)}%)

`; } message += '━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━
🕐 ' + new Date().toLocaleString('en-US', { timeZone: 'UTC', dateStyle: 'medium', timeStyle: 'short' }) + ' UTC'; return { message };
